extraction: Figure S24 and Table S25 source CSVs are equal-scenario aggregates extracted from the two authoritative completed-run summary CSVs. No candidate bank, GA, model fit, or empirical analysis was rerun.
execution_note: The frozen protocol listed engineering chunk sizes of 1000 or larger. The R=100 sensitivity used chunks of 250 to limit memory. Randomness was keyed to scenario and replicate identifiers and was chunk independent; all checksum and deterministic-regeneration audits passed.
claim_boundary: Hidden synthetic utility is not AUROC. The simulation evaluates candidate-bank locking only and does not establish predictive superiority, unbiased generalization, external validity, participant-resampling stability, biomarker stability, or clinical utility.
